scope: restart recovery, interrupted dispatch/provisioning/control intents, stale sessions and stranded workers (src/coordinator.ts, src/store.ts, src/serve.ts, src/serve-command.ts, src/runtime.ts, src/providers/opencode.ts, src/domain.ts)

findings.title: recovery_required is terminal and unresumable even when the coordinator parked the worker on a paused/stopped guest, and the emitted error tells the operator to resume
findings.evidence: runControl accepts resume only when w.state === 'paused' (:830-831, throws 'Worker is not paused'); recovery_required is in terminal (src/domain.ts:17-23); runRecover returns for terminal states at :420 before the paused/stopped mapping at :421-432, making the !terminal.has guard at :429 dead code; runTick filters terminal states out at :344-349. Entry points reproduced: interrupted submit -> recovery_required 'Prompt delivery ambiguous' on a running idle guest (:561-579, :575); stopped guest -> recovery_required 'VM stopped; inspect before resuming' (:429-432); quiesce that could only pause the guest -> recovery_required (:785-804, :909-926). applyControl can already resume a paused guest (:915-916) and holds resumeWorker (:859), both unreachable for these workers. The retained VM keeps consuming SWARMFORGE_MAX_WORKERS capacity (:317-322).
findings.reproduction: Disposable lab /tmp/opencode/rev07/lab with Bun 1.4.2 and tests/helpers FakeProvider/FakeAgent. probes/p1.test.ts P1: worker to running, guest state 'stopped', recover() -> recovery_required, control(id,'resume') -> 'Worker is not paused', second restart + recover + tick unchanged. probes/p1.test.ts P2: agent.abort throws and exec fails for 'systemctl stop' -> recovery_required with guest 'paused'; resume refused again after restart. probes/p2.test.ts P5: dispatch left 'sending' with an idle session and no message -> first tick recovery_required with guest 'running'; resume refused. probes/p3.test.ts P8: send_worker_message does recover it (recovery_required -> booting -> running) but cancels the original dispatch, runs = ['cancelled:Implement a feature','sent:please continue'], so the spawned prompt is never re-delivered. probes/p2.test.ts P4: with SWARMFORGE_MAX_WORKERS=2, two retained-VM workers keep a third spawn 'queued' and provider.created stays 2.
findings.recommendation: Make the recovery path match the emitted messages: handle a paused/stopped guest for a terminal recovery_required worker before the terminal return in runRecover (transition to paused with previous_state), or accept resume when state is recovery_required and the guest is paused/stopped (resumeWorker then transition to previous_state ?? 'ready'). Otherwise reword both errors to 'destroy or send a follow-up' and surface the stranded dispatch's message text so the prompt is recoverable.

findings.title: result.json fallback requires the optional run_id, so a schema-valid file result is discarded when the session is unreadable
findings.evidence: fallback() returns null unless r.run_id === d.run_id (:685), while resultSchema marks run_id optional (src/domain.ts:45) and identify() overwrites run_id with the dispatch's run id anyway (:665-672), so the check is only a staleness guard applied inconsistently with the message path (:589-593).
findings.reproduction: probes/p3.test.ts P7: settled session with no reply plus a result file without run_id -> worker 'waiting', store.result() null; the same file with run_id -> 'completed'.
findings.recommendation: Treat a missing run_id as matching when it is the only unresolved dispatch for that worker, or record the dispatch run id in the artifact the bootstrap already writes; at minimum report the discarded result in the worker error so a successful report is not silently lost.
